name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
title: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd - 539450 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Fragrance maker guides adjusted EBITDA margin ~13% for H1 FY27 and FY27 capex of Rs 140 crore, but refuses full-year guidance amid raw-material inflation; Rs 350 crore capex plus Rs 80-85 crore annual dev-centre opex still not earning returns.

capex.quote: FY27 capex will be around Rs. 140 crore of capex. This is all the capex, most of it is in front-ended first two quarters.

triggers.label: Cash conversion cycle ~140 days
triggers.quote: the cash conversion cycle is around 140 days at the moment

triggers.label: No full-year guidance; H1 only
triggers.quote: we are not really in a position to give you a full-year view

triggers.label: Raw material inventory prices up 12-13%+
triggers.quote: the inventory prices are going up, it is very difficult to put an exact number, but upwards of 12%, 13% plus

triggers.label: Price increases secured from global accounts
triggers.quote: we are pleased that even the large global accounts have sort of responded and confirmed their commitment to the supply with price increases to us

triggers.label: Share gain as smaller rivals lack buffer
triggers.quote: I think first few weeks of this quarter also we believe that we have gained market share in the Indian market especially

guidance.quote: we will wait and watch and see and take corrective steps as necessary to ensure that we do not fall below the 12%, 13% EBITDA level
FY27 capex will be around Rs. 140 crore of capex.
Borrowing should remain around the Rs. 800 crore mark.
our reported EBITDA which is a 10% is going to be 14% by end of FY29
I am actually confident that we will hit the Rs. 300 crore plus EBITDA for this year.
we will be able to maintain 42% and thereabout for the first half of the year
every passing year we should reduce our debt by 10%

prior_guidance_check.metric: Adjusted EBITDA margin rising 13% to 17% over 2-3 years
prior_guidance_check.quote: We have not seen that yet. Any particular reason for the delay and by when can we see that?
our reported EBITDA which is a 10% is going to be 14% by end of FY29

red_flags.label: No full-year FY27 guidance
red_flags.quote: we are not really in a position to give you a full-year view

red_flags.label: Dev-centre losses Rs 80-85 crore a year
red_flags.quote: It is roughly when you look at all these three combined in the range of Rs. 80 crore to Rs. 85 crore annually

red_flags.label: Rs 35 crore one-off low-margin liquidation flatters Q4
red_flags.quote: we reported a one -off sale of approximately INR 35 crores of low -margin produc ts

red_flags.label: Debt to rise near term; cash cycle 140 days
red_flags.quote: we might see it is going to go up from where we are as on today

evasions.quote: I think this is a very, I would say, difficult question to answer.
at this point of time, it is a different priorities and different situation
it will take longer than that
